assumptions: Nonrelativistic isolated atom; infinite-mass point nucleus.
Reduced radial orbitals on a second-order uniform finite-difference grid.
He is restricted to a closed-shell spherical 1s² state; both HF and LDA_X omit correlation.
units: Atomic units in the displayed electronic equations (hbar = m_e = e = 4 pi epsilon_0 = 1); dimensionless conventions are stated where needed.
boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(r_max)=0; hydrogenic r_max=60 bohr, He r_max=16 bohr, with separate domain studies.

next_deliverable.ja: 使用する汎関数・グリッド・基底の明示と出典整理。
next_deliverable.en: Document functional, grid, basis and primary references.

limitations.ja: スピン非偏極Dirac交換のエネルギーと汎関数微分のみを検証。LDA相関、GGA、meta-GGA、hybridは解説のみ。
limitations.en: Only spin-unpolarized Dirac exchange energy and its functional derivative are verified; LDA correlation, GGA, meta-GGA and hybrids remain reading-only.

metadata_review.level: scoped radial educational implementation; analytic and independently computed PySCF reference checks; see separate quantum-atoms code edition

assumptions_ja: 非相対論・孤立原子・無限質量の点核。
一様動径格子と2次中心差分による縮約動径軌道。
Heは閉殻・球対称1s²に限定し、HFとLDA_Xともに相関を含まない。
units_ja: 表示する電子状態の式は原子単位系（ℏ = m_e = e = 4πε₀ = 1）。無次元量や占有の規約は各節に明記。
boundary_conditions_ja: u(0)=u(r_max)=0。水素型はr_max=60 bohr、Heは16 bohrを基本に領域依存を別途検査。

caution.ja: 基底・格子・SCFが収束しても汎関数の近似誤差は消えません。自己相互作用、電荷移動、強相関、分散の扱いは対象と近似に応じて評価します。
caution.en: Basis, grid and SCF convergence do not remove functional error. Assess self-interaction, charge transfer, strong correlation and dispersion for the chosen system and approximation.

example_scope.ja: スピン非偏極Dirac交換のエネルギーと汎関数微分のみを検証。LDA相関、GGA、meta-GGA、hybridは解説のみ。
example_scope.en: Only spin-unpolarized Dirac exchange energy and its functional derivative are verified; LDA correlation, GGA, meta-GGA and hybrids remain reading-only.
